questions.q_en: In a triangle ABC, PQ is a straight line parallel to AC, such that Area ABC: Area PBQ = 3: 1. Then CB : CQ is equal to:

questions.solution_en:
Area of ∆ ABC : ∆PBQ = 3 : 1
Then, Side ratio = CB ∶ BQ = √3 : 1
CQ = BC - BQ = √3 - 1
The required ratio = CB : CQ = √3 : √3-1
= × = [√3 + 1]

तब, भुजा अनुपात = CB ∶ BQ = √3 : 1
CQ = BC -BQ = √3 -1
आवश्यक अनुपात = CB : CQ = √3 : √3-1
= × = [√3 + 1]

questions.q_en: In the given triangle, CD is the bisector of BCA. CD = DA. If BDC = 76°, what is the measure of CBD (in degree)?
questions.q_hi: दिए गए त्रिभुज में, CD, BCA का समद्विभाजक है। CD = DA. यदि BDC = 76° है, तो CBD का माप (डिग्री में) क्या है?
options_en: 32°

options_hi: 32°

questions.solution_en:
Given that CD in angle bisector,
CD = DA,
∠BDC = 76°
Let ∠CAD = x ̊, then
∠CAD = ∠DCA = x ̊ [∵CD = DA]
& ∠BCD =∠DCA =x ̊[angle bisector]
∠BDC = x + x =2x ̊[Exterior angle]
∴2x = 76 ̊
x = 38 ̊
So, in △BCD
3x + ∠CBD = 180 ̊
3 × 38 + ∠CBD = 180 ̊
∠CBD = 180 114 = 66 ̊

questions.q_en: The sum of the measures of 7 interior angles of an 8 -sided polygon is 1000°. What is the measure of the 8th exterior angle of the polygon?
questions.q_hi: 8 भुजाओं वाले एक बहुभुज के 7 आंतरिक कोणों के मापों का योग 1000° है। इस बहुभुज के 8वें बाह्य कोण का माप क्या है?
options_en: 1080
1180
1000
800
options_hi: 1080
1180
1000
800
questions.solution_en:
Each exterior angle =(360°)/n (n ; number of side)

= (360°)/8=45°

Each interior angle = 180°-45° = 135°

(∵ Exterior + interior angle = 180°, in a polygon)

Sum of all interior angle = 135°×8=1080°

given = Sum of 7 interior angle = 1000°

8th interior angle = (1080°-1000°)

= 80°

⇒So, 8th exterior angle = 180°-80°=100°
questions.solution_hi:
प्रत्येक बाहरी कोण = (360°)/n (n = भुजाओं की संख्या)

= (360°)/8 = 45°

प्रत्येक आंतरिक कोण = 180° - 45° = 135°

(∵ किसी बहुभुज में बाहरी + आंतरिक कोण = 180°)

सभी आंतरिक कोणों का योग = 135° × 8 = 1080°

दिया गया है = 7 आंतरिक कोणों का योग = 1000°

8वाँ आंतरिक कोण = (1080° - 1000°)

= 80°

⇒ इसलिए 8वाँ बाहरी कोण = 180° - 80° = 100°
